backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining types and state maps for users, cars, races, teams, holidays, and admin actions with access control and migration support.
backend/migration.mo: Stub migration module returning an empty migrated actor structure.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file summarizing all frontend source files and their functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base setup defining light and dark theme variables and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the SPA root and main TypeScript module with cache-busting meta tags.
frontend/PUBLISH_RUNBOOK.md: Deployment runbook describing publish steps, verification checks, troubleshooting, and rollback procedures.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the root router and all application routes with layout, pages, and admin-guarded sections.
frontend/src/assets/generatedAssets.ts: Exports paths to generated image assets including car packs and seasonal backgrounds.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccessDeni: UI component showing an access denied message with navigation back to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAudit: Simple audit log component displaying static admin action entries in a scrollable card.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Route guard that restricts admin pages to logged-in users with a completed profile.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog that appears for new authenticated users to enter username and display name, then saves their profile.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main app layout handling navigation, internet identity auth, seasonal backgrounds, and toolbar links.
frontend/src/components/race/carModelPro: Defines dimensional profiles for various car models used for 3D rendering and 2D markers.
frontend/src/components/race/CarViewer3D: 3D car viewer using three.js that renders and animates a car model based on provided profile and color.
frontend/src/components/race/TrackCarMar: Renders a small 2D top‑down car marker using model profile dimensions and selected color.
frontend/src/components/race/TrackVisual: Displays player and ghost opponent positions on a horizontal track using car markers.
frontend/src/components/race/WordZoneInd: Shows the user's word zone, target word count, and WPM info in compact or full card form.
frontend/src/hooks/useActiveCar.ts: Stores and updates the active car ID in localStorage using a React hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current identity and invalidates dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides hooks to check admin status and retrieve the caller’s user role via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useBans.ts: Defines mutations to ban and unban users by principal and refreshes related profile queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useEconomy.ts: Implements admin economy actions like granting coins and setting balances, plus a placeholder race completion hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useGhostOpponents.ts: Stubbed ghost opponent hook returning no opponents due to disabled leaderboard support.
frontend/src/hooks/useHolidays.ts: Stubbed holiday query and mutation hooks with backend functionality not yet implemented.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity authentication state, login, logout, and identity loading via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useInventory.ts: Fetches the current user’s inventory based on their Internet Identity principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useLeaderboards.ts: Stubbed leaderboard hook returning empty data until backend support exists.
frontend/src/hooks/useMotd.ts: Provides a static MOTD string with no backend integration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains hooks for profiles, inventory, roles, car catalog, and purchases using the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSeason.ts: Retrieves and updates the current competitive season via backend actor calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useTeams.ts: Stubbed team-related queries and mutations pending backend implementation.
frontend/src/hooks/useUpdateAssistant.ts: Executes update assistant actions through the backend and returns the result or errors.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and defines theme variables, base styles, and utility classes including glow effects.
frontend/src/lib/adminCommandParser.ts: Parses admin command strings into structured actions like setting balance, banning users, or creating items.
frontend/src/lib/raceMetrics.ts: Computes WPM, accuracy, and aggregates race metrics from character counts and elapsed time.
frontend/src/lib/raceTextGeneration.ts: Generates race text based on word pools and user WPM, with helpers for storing and retrieving WPM.
frontend/src/lib/wordZones.ts: Maps WPM ranges to word-count zones and selects target counts for text generation.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBanManagem: Admin interface for banning and unbanning users by principal ID with validation and toasts.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBannersPag: Stub admin page indicating future banner management functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCarsPage.t: Stub admin page indicating future car management functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCarTemplat: Stub admin page indicating future car template management functionality.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCustomizeI: Provides a grid of links for managing cars, templates, banners, trails, nitros, and titles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminEconomyToo: Implements interfaces to grant TRP Coins or set user balances, including validation and mutation calls.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminHomePage.t: Displays the main admin dashboard linking to texts, customization, economy, bans, MOTD, and admin management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminManagement: Allows granting or revoking admin privileges by validating and submitting a Principal ID.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminMotdPage.t: Placeholder page for configuring the Message of the Day.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminNitrosPage: Placeholder interface for managing nitro effects.
Placeholder interface for managing race texts.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTitlesPage: Placeholder interface for managing player titles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTrailsPage: Placeholder interface for managing trail effects.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUpdateAssi: Parses admin commands and executes mapped backend actions like balance changes, bans, and season updates.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TextDemoPage.ts: Placeholder page for testing race texts.
frontend/src/pages/CustomizePage.tsx: Displays UI for customizing cars and other items, loading user inventory and allowing active car selection.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Shows the main dashboard with racing links, user profile info, and loading states depending on authentication.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardsPage.tsx: Renders leaderboard category tabs and a placeholder card for upcoming leaderboard data.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the logged-in user's profile stats with loading and login-required states.
frontend/src/pages/RaceHistoryPage.tsx: Shows a login check and a placeholder for upcoming race history functionality.
frontend/src/pages/RaceLobbyPage.tsx: Provides race mode selection, previews word zone info, and starts races after a short delay.
frontend/src/pages/RacePage.tsx: Runs the typing race logic, tracks metrics, animates progress, and saves results before navigation.
frontend/src/pages/RaceResultsPage.tsx: Loads stored race results, displays performance metrics, and handles login-related save status messaging.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Displays the car shop, grouping models, selecting colors, showing ownership, and handling purchases with loading states and identity checks.
frontend/src/pages/SystemPage.tsx: Admin system controls for managing holidays and setting the season, with dialogs, validation, and profile-based permissions.
frontend/src/pages/TeamDetailsPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a specific team, including members, founder status, balance, and membership indicators.
frontend/src/pages/TeamsPage.tsx: Lists all teams and provides a dialog to create a new team with balance checks and error handling.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides helpers to read URL parameters (including hash routing) and persist them in sessionStorage, plus utilities to clear stored or hash parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, radii, fonts, shadows, and enabling plugins for animation and typography.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining feature requests and state for implementing admin-role logic, including special handling for the '@Admin' user.
